name: Gearbox
text: Deploy the Cerebras CS-3 with the Llama 3.4 70B model as EXCAVA’s primary engine. This combination maximizes processing power and model performance, significantly improving output accuracy and response times. The trade-off involves the resource allocation needed for the CS-3, but the resulting increase in capability justifies the investment.

name: Torque
text: The Cerebras CS-3 with Llama 3.4 70B locks you into a single vendor’s hardware and software stack—no escape if prices spike or their roadmap shifts. A better path is testing the new Llama 4 models on open hardware like AMD MI325X or NVIDIA H100, measuring real throughput gains before committing. Settle it with a controlled benchmark: run identical prompts on both setups and compare tokens/second and output quality—no vendor claims, just raw data.
